lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently performed poorly across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Adding wait-time information on the home screen was helpful across 4 winning tests, while 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption step redesigns were helpful across 2 winning tests, with 1 test showing no clear effect.
Changes to sign-in copy, sign-in hints, sign-in notifications, choose-path copy, and finish new-flow flows consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for categories with only 1 test or split results, such as adoption copy, adoption new-flow, choose-path layout, finish redesign, and home redesign.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that yielded no clear effect or performed worse.
